title: Balancing Prayer Times at the Office
paragraphs: Malik starts a new job. His company does not have a prayer room. He is not sure how to pray during a busy day with many meetings.
In his first week, Malik asks his manager a question. He asks if he can use an empty meeting room for a few minutes at Dhuhr. He worries that people may not like the request.
His manager agrees at once. Another coworker already does something similar. Malik sees that he worried too much and that no one at the office is upset.
One month later, Malik has prayer breaks in his daily plan. He is grateful that he asked clearly instead of worrying in silence.
